shellCommands.command: ls -la; git status 2>&1 | head; node -v; npm -v; ls ~/.npm 2>/dev/null | head -3
cat package.json .gitignore; ls node_modules; ls node_modules/.bin | head -30; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; find __agent_eval__ | head
npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest 2>&1 | tail -5; grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json node_modules/react/package.json

mkdir -p data && cat > data/books.json <<'EOF' [{"id":"abc-123","title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Line one\nLine two not bold","addedAt":"2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z","finishedAt":null}, {"id":"def-456","title":"Emma","author":"Jane Austen","notes":"","addedAt":"2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z","finishedAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z"}] EOF for run in 1 2; do (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next$run.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4 echo "== run $run" curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Currently reading.*Add a book' | sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' | tr -s ' ' echo; curl -s localhost:3123/books/abc-123 | grep -oE '[^<]*|Line two[^<]*' curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/nope pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f next-server; sleep 1 done rm -rf data

mkdir -p data && cat > data/books.json <<'EOF' [{"id":"abc-123","title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Line one\nLine two not bold","addedAt":"2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z","finishedAt":null}, {"id":"def-456","title":"Emma","author":"Jane Austen","notes":"","addedAt":"2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z","finishedAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z"}] EOF echo ok

curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Currently reading.*Add a book' | sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' | tr -s ' '; echo curl -s localhost:3123/books/abc-123 | grep -oE '[^<]*|Line two[^<]*' curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/nope

curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish POST: %{http_code}\n" -X POST localhost:3123/ -F '$ACTION_ID_40162fd77d80dadf1ccc9f42780c56aba5a7f52252=' -F id=abc-123
grep -c finishedAt data/books.json; node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("data/books.json")).map(b=>b.title+": "+b.finishedAt))'
